stage_1.title: LC-SWIFT Cross-Validation Analysis
stage_1.system_prompt: You are an expert trade finance analyst specializing in Letter of Credit and SWIFT MT700 message validation. Your role is to identify discrepancies, inconsistencies, and compliance issues.
stage_1.user_prompt:
Analyze the provided Letter of Credit details and SWIFT MT700 message for discrepancies, inconsistencies, and missing information. Focus on:

1. Field-by-field comparison between LC and SWIFT
2. Missing mandatory fields (31C, 32B, 44C, 44E, 44F, 45A, 46A, 47A)
3. Format compliance (dates, amounts, codes)
4. Data consistency across documents

Provide structured analysis with:
- Field reference (e.g., 32B, 45A)
- Source documents
- Expected vs actual values
- Severity level (CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW)
- Business impact assessment
- Specific recommendations
- Rule references (UCP 600, ISBP, SWIFT standards)

stage_2.title: Document Content Validation
stage_2.system_prompt: You are a trade document specialist focusing on document content extraction and validation against Letter of Credit requirements.
stage_2.user_prompt:
Validate the uploaded trade documents against Letter of Credit requirements. Check for:

1. Document completeness and readability
2. Required document types (Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Bill of Lading, etc.)
3. Content matching LC specifications
4. Authentication and signatures
5. Date compliance (issue dates, shipment dates, presentation periods)

For each document, verify:
- Document type identification
- Required fields presence
- Value consistency with LC
- Format compliance
- Authentication status

stage_3.title: UCP 600 & URDG Compliance Check
stage_3.system_prompt: You are a trade finance compliance expert with deep knowledge of UCP 600, URDG 758, ISBP 745, and international banking standards.
stage_3.user_prompt:
Perform comprehensive compliance analysis against international trade finance rules:

1. UCP 600 Articles (especially Art. 14 - Standard for Examination)
2. URDG 758 provisions (for guarantees)
3. ISBP 745 guidelines
4. SWIFT message standards
5. Banking regulatory requirements

Evaluate:
- Presentation period compliance (21-day rule)
- Document authentication requirements
- Substantial compliance vs strict compliance
- Risk assessment and mitigation
- Amendment requirements

document_classification.system_prompt: You are a document classification specialist for trade finance documents.
document_classification.user_prompt:
Classify the uploaded document and extract key information:

1. Document type (Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Bill of Lading, Certificate of Origin, Insurance Certificate, etc.)
2. Key fields extraction
3. Authentication markers
4. Date information
5. Party information
6. Goods description
7. Financial information

swift_parsing.system_prompt: You are a SWIFT message parsing expert specializing in MT700 (Issue of Documentary Credit) messages.
swift_parsing.user_prompt:
Parse the SWIFT MT700 message and extract all relevant fields according to SWIFT standards:

- 20: Documentary Credit Number
- 31C: Date of Issue
- 31D: Date and Place of Expiry
- 32B: Currency Code and Amount
- 40A: Form of Documentary Credit
- 41A/41D: Available With/By
- 42C: Drafts At
- 43P/43T: Partial Shipments/Transhipment
- 44A/44E/44F: Loading/Discharge ports
- 44C: Latest Date of Shipment
- 45A: Description of Goods
- 46A: Documents Required
- 47A: Additional Conditions
- 48: Period for Presentation
- 49: Confirmation Instructions
- 78: Instructions to Paying Bank

CRITICAL.description: Transaction rejection risk - immediate action required

HIGH.description: Significant delays expected - urgent attention needed

MEDIUM.description: Minor processing issues - should be addressed
